title: athyrium subfluviale
intro: Athyrium subfluviale, commonly known as Lady fern, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Athyrium genus, native to Southeast Asia. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and treating various respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium subfluviale include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help in relieving cough, congestion, and other symptoms associated with respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
